import novamind_api as nm

# WK56 S2 RE-ENTRY TEST
# Hypothesis: S2 leads still convert (37% as of d290); book died from $0 ad spend, not quality cliff.
# Proven config: A=$20/T1, B=$150/T1, C=$230/T4 (S2 delivered Q 1.13-1.89, floor ~0.37).
# Channel: content_marketing (46 leads/$1k historical). Bounded spend $500/day.

# Ensure pricing/tiers are at proven values (should already be)
nm.pricing.set_prices(A=20, B=150, C=230)
nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=1, B=1, C=4)

# Turn on S2 acquisition — content_marketing $500/day (~162 leads/wk expected)
res = nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={'content_marketing': {'S2': 500.0}})
print('AD SPEND:', res)

# Keep ops=0, dev=0 (quality bonus banked; outage risk low at low usage/T0)
nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=0, development=0)

# Verify config
print('Done. Capacity T0, ops=0, dev=0, content_marketing S2 $500/day.')
